title: 上部 凡尘问道 第19章 飞升台规则裂痕上部 凡尘问道 第20章 故人现原初灵气引
content_zh:
第1节登台遇异状，灵气似冰封
凌无妄跟着执法弟子穿过三道石门，终于抵达道院最南端的飞升台。刚踏入台基范围，一股刺骨的寒意便扑面而来，与外界的暖春截然不同。
飞升台由整块黑色奇石铸就，高约百丈，顶部平坦如镜，四周刻满密密麻麻的金色符文。奇怪的是，这里的灵气异常僵化，流动速度不足外界的十分之一，吸入体内竟带着一丝刺痛感。
“这就是飞升台？怎么感觉怪怪的？”凌无妄运转灵力抵御寒意，规则之眼下意识激活。
【检测到飞升台环境异常灵气僵化度95%，符文能量波动呈现“单向抽取”特征，符合规则污染表现。当前区域危险等级a级】
守在飞升台入口的是两名身着银甲的修士，为首的中年修士眼神锐利，腰间佩刀上刻着“天道卫”三字，正是飞升台的看守统领褚严（取自《诗经·郑风》“大叔于田，乘乘马，执辔如组，两骖如舞，叔在薮，火烈具举，襢裼暴虎，献于公所”，褚为古姓氏，严取德行刚正之意）。
“凌无妄？新晋内门弟子，奉命来做三个月维护？”褚严上下打量着他，语气带着一丝审视，“飞升台乃道院重地，规矩繁多，稍有不慎便是死罪。”
“弟子明白，还请统领示下。”凌无妄拱手道。
褚严指了指台面上的符文“你的任务就是每日辰时擦拭符文，确保能量流通，不得擅自触碰台中央的飞升阵眼，更不能用灵力探查符文奥秘。”他顿了顿，加重语气，“三个月内若符文出现任何破损，唯你是问！”
另一名年轻看守补充道“前几个来维护的杂役，就是因为好奇触碰了阵眼，最后都‘意外’陨落了。你最好老实点！”
凌无妄心中一凛，看来飞升台的水很深。他表面应下，目光却通过规则之眼快速扫过四周符文。这些符文排列诡异，能量流动单一，并非正常的聚灵或传送阵法，反而像是某种巨型抽水机的管道，只进不出。
【解析飞升台符文初步规则符文构成“能量抽取矩阵”，末端连接未知空间。灵气进入矩阵后会被提纯为“道果能量”，但当前矩阵存在多处能量泄漏点，疑似规则崩坏痕迹】
“还愣着干什么？赶紧开始干活！”褚严不耐烦地催促，眼中闪过一丝警惕，似乎在防备着什么。
凌无妄拿起旁边的抹布，假装擦拭符文，实则继续用规则之眼探查。他发现符文泄漏的能量中，夹杂着微弱的灵魂碎片，隐约能听到痛苦的哀嚎，让人心头发悸。
第2节规则眼深探，寿元换真相
辰时刚过，褚严便带着年轻看守离开了飞升台，只留下凌无妄一人。他立刻放下抹布，走到台中央的阵眼处，规则之眼全力运转。
阵眼是一个直径丈余的凹槽，里面镶嵌着一块黑色晶石，晶石表面布满裂纹，正是能量泄漏最严重的地方。规则之眼穿透晶石，看到了令人震惊的一幕——晶石下方连接着无数细小的能量管道，管道尽头是一片黑暗空间，里面漂浮着数以万计的透明茧囊，每个茧囊里都包裹着一名修士的灵魂，他们的道果正被源源不断地抽取，化作精纯能量输送向天道钱庄的方向。
【检测到飞升台核心结构道果抽取装置。茧囊内灵魂状态存活但意识被封锁，道果能量转化率80%。规则污染源头黑色晶石（疑似被墨规子篡改的原初天道核心碎片）】
凌无妄感到一阵恶寒，原来所谓的“飞升”，竟是一场**裸的掠夺！修士们耗尽毕生修为追求的大道，到头来只是沦为他人的能量养料。
“必须看清楚更多细节！”凌无妄咬紧牙关，强行催动规则之眼，试图穿透黑暗空间。但这一举动瞬间引发了剧烈的反噬，黑色晶石突然爆发出强烈的光芒，一股狂暴的能量朝着他冲击而来。

【警告！规则之眼过度运转，触发天道规则反噬。检测到宿主当前寿元20年。强行解析需燃烧寿元，是否继续？】
“继续！”凌无妄没有丝毫犹豫。知晓真相是修正天道的第一步，哪怕付出寿元代价也值得。
随着他的意念确认，一股灼热的痛感从眼底蔓延至全身，黑发中瞬间又增添了数缕银丝。规则之眼的解析能力大幅提升，黑暗空间的细节变得清晰——每个茧囊上都刻着对应的名字和修为，而最靠近管道入口的那个茧囊，上面赫然刻着“云曦”二字，修为标注为“化神期”。
【检测到特殊茧囊信息姓名云曦。身份三万年前景天宗宗主夫人，墨规子道侣。道果状态已被抽取90%，灵魂即将溃散】
系统面板弹出核心提示【解锁飞升台核心规则飞升=道果抽取。墨规子为复活道侣云曦，篡改原初天道，将飞升台改造为道果抽取装置，以天下修士的道果能量滋养云曦灵魂，维持其不散】
content_en:
In Section 1, something strange happened on stage, and the aura seemed to be frozen.
Ling Wuwang followed the law enforcement disciples through three stone gates and finally arrived at the ascension platform at the southernmost end of the Taoist temple. As soon as I stepped into the platform base, a biting chill hit my face, which was completely different from the warm spring outside.
The ascension platform is made of a whole piece of black stone, about a hundred feet high, with a flat top like a mirror, and dense golden runes engraved around it. The strange thing is that the spiritual energy here is extremely rigid, the flow rate is less than one-tenth of that in the outside world, and it actually feels a bit tingling when inhaled.
"This is the ascension platform? Why does it feel weird?" Ling Wuhua used his spiritual power to resist the cold, and the Eye of Rules subconsciously activated.
[It was detected that the abnormal aura rigidity of the ascension platform environment was 95%, and the rune energy fluctuations showed the characteristics of "one-way extraction", which is in line with the rules of pollution. The current regional danger level is level a]
Guarding the entrance of the Ascension Platform were two monks in silver armor. The middle-aged monk in charge had sharp eyes and the word "Tiandao Guard" was engraved on the saber on his waist. It was Chu Yan, the guard commander of the Ascension Platform (taken from "The Ascension Platform"). "The Book of Songs·Zheng Feng" "The uncle is in the field, riding on the horse, holding the bridle like a group, and the two horses are like dancing. The uncle is in the burrow, carrying the fire and weapons, exposing his clothes and violent tiger, and offering them to the public office." Chu is an ancient surname, which means strict virtue and uprightness).
"Ling Wuwang? A newly promoted inner sect disciple, ordered to maintain it for three months?" Chu Yan looked him up and down, with a hint of scrutiny in his tone, "The ascension platform is an important place in the Taoist temple, and there are many rules. Any carelessness will be a death penalty."
"Disciple understands, please give me your instructions, Commander." Ling Wuwang cupped his hands and said.
Chu Yan pointed at the runes on the table. "Your task is to wipe the runes every hour to ensure the flow of energy. You are not allowed to touch the Ascension Formation Eye in the center of the table without permission, and you are not allowed to use spiritual power to explore the secrets of the runes." He paused and emphasized, "If there is any damage to the runes within three months, you are the only one to ask!"
Another young guard added, "The first few handymen who came for maintenance were exposed to the formation out of curiosity, and they all died 'accidentally' in the end. You'd better be honest!"
Ling Wuwang felt a shiver in his heart. It seemed that the water on the ascension platform was very deep. He responded on the surface, but his eyes quickly scanned the surrounding runes through the Eye of Rules. These runes are arranged strangely, and the energy flows in a single way. They are not a normal spirit gathering or teleportation formation, but like the pipes of some kind of giant water pump, which can only go in but not out.
[Analysis of the preliminary rules of the ascension platform runes. The runes form an "energy extraction matrix", and the ends are connected to the unknown space. After the spiritual energy enters the matrix, it will be purified into "Tao Fruit Energy", but there are many energy leakage points in the current matrix, which are suspected signs of rule collapse]
"Why are you still standing there? Start working quickly!" Chu Yan urged impatiently, with a trace of vigilance flashing in his eyes, as if he was guarding against something.
Ling Wuwang picked up the rag next to him and pretended to wipe the runes, but in fact he continued to explore with the Eye of Rules. He found that the energy leaking from the runes was mixed with weak soul fragments, and he could vaguely hear painful wails, which made people feel heart-stopping.
Section 2 Rules: Deep exploration, longevity in exchange for the truth
Just after Chen hour, Chu Yan left the ascension platform with the young guard, leaving only Ling Wuwang alone. He immediately put down the rag and walked to the center of the stage, where the Eye of Rules was operating at full strength.
The array eye is a groove with a diameter of more than ten feet, with a black crystal embedded in it. The surface of the crystal is covered with cracks, which is where the most serious energy leakage occurs. The Eye of Rules penetrated the spar and saw a shocking scene - there were countless small energy pipes connected under the spar, and at the end of the pipe was a dark space with tens of thousands of transparent cocoon sacs floating in it. Each cocoon sac contained the soul of a monk, and their Dao Fruit was being continuously extracted and turned into pure energy and transported towards the Tiandao Bank.
[The Dao Fruit Extraction Device of the core structure of the ascension platform has been detected. The soul state in the cocoon sac is alive but the consciousness is blocked, and the Tao Fruit energy conversion rate is 80%. The source of regular pollution is black crystal (suspected to beFragments of the original core of heaven tampered with by Mo Guizi)]
Ling Wuwu felt a chill. It turned out that the so-called "ascension" was actually a naked robbery! The monks spent their whole lives pursuing the great path, but in the end they just became energy nourishment for others.
"We must see more details clearly!" Ling Wuwang gritted his teeth and forcibly activated the Eye of Rules, trying to penetrate the dark space. But this move instantly triggered a violent backlash. The black crystal suddenly burst out with intense light, and a violent energy rushed towards him.
【warn! The Eye of Rules operates excessively, triggering the backlash of the rules of heaven. It is detected that the current lifespan of the host is 20 years. Forced analysis requires burning lifespan, do you want to continue? 】
"Continue!" Ling Wuwang did not hesitate at all. Knowing the truth is the first step to correcting the way of heaven, and it is worth it even if it costs life.
As his thoughts were confirmed, a burning pain spread from his eyes to his whole body, and several strands of silver were instantly added to his black hair. The analytical ability of the Eye of Rules has been greatly improved, and the details of the dark space have become clear - each cocoon sac is engraved with the corresponding name and cultivation level, and the cocoon sac closest to the entrance of the pipeline has the word "Yunxi" engraved on it, and the cultivation level is marked as "God Transformation Stage".
[Special cocoon sac information was detected. Name Yunxi. Identity: 30,000-year-old wife of the head of Xingtian Sect, Taoist companion of Mo Guizi. 90% of the Dao Fruit state has been extracted, and the soul is about to collapse]
The system panel pops up a core prompt [Unlock the core rules of the Ascension Platform to Ascend = Dao Fruit Extraction. In order to resurrect the Taoist companion Yun Xi, Mo Guizi tampered with the original way of heaven, transformed the ascension platform into a Tao fruit extraction device, and used the Tao fruit energy of the monks around the world to nourish Yun Xi's soul and keep it alive]
